items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: He was a famous drummer with the original Tuxedo Band. Abbie Foster was his right name. We all called him Chani Bebe.

ctx.x: He was a famous drummer with the original Tuxedo Band. Abbie Foster was his right name. We all called him Chani Bebe.
